landing.badge: Built by the community, for the community
landing.title: Bangladesh's open home for software developers
landing.subtitle: BSDC brings the social graph, technical publishing, communities and Q&A together in one platform — designed mobile-first for Bangladesh, open to developers everywhere, in Bangla and English.
landing.aboutBody: BSDC merges the core mechanics of social networks, developer publishing, community forums and Q&A into a single product — with Bangla and English as co-equal languages from day one.

pillars.connectBody: Follow developers, join public, closed or secret groups, and take part in events and RSVPs.
pillars.publishBody: Write articles, share code snippets with syntax highlighting, and showcase your projects.
pillars.discussBody: Ask questions, vote on what matters, and build reputation through threaded discussion.
pillars.messageBody: Real-time chat with typing indicators, presence, voice notes and message requests.

landing.roadmapBody: Phased and verified — no faked features. Each phase ships only after the previous one passes its verification checklist.
landing.contactBody: Questions, partnerships or feedback — reach the BSDC team directly.
